posts.name: Decision Desk HQ
posts.text:
Last night was the largest blue wave in a generation.

Democrats have been projected as winner in 54 Senate seats, flipping seven states and with a lead in two others (Alaska and Mississippi).

In the House, Democrats have been projected in 249 seats - a net gain of 38 so far.

DDHQ FORECAST UPDATE (11/3): FINAL UPDATE

posts.name: Matthew Yglesias
posts.text: Even a very Republican-skewing judicial branch has been a meaningful check on Trump and flipping the senate — and only flipping the senate — stops Trump from stacking the judiciary with cultists who'll remove that check.

posts.name: CNN Politics
posts.text: Democratic state Rep. James Talarico will win the Senate race in Texas, CNN projects, delivering a stunning defeat to Republican state Attorney General Ken Paxton. Talarico is the first Democrat elected to represent Texas in the US Senate in 38 years.

posts.name: CNN Politics
posts.text: Democrats are projected to oust at least 30 Republican incumbents in this year's midterms, surpassing 250 House seats on the party's way to its largest majority since the 2008 election.

posts.name: Erick Erickson
posts.text: For the last two years, the Trump Administration has been governed by a simple mantra: “We can just do things.” On Tuesday, voters replied, “So can we,” and wiped out the GOP. This was not a blue wave. This was not a blue tsunami. This was the breakup of a winning coalition.
